title: Content that converts: captions, Reels and replies

say: A strong caption has three parts. The hook is the first line, the only part people see before tapping more. Good morning everyone is weak. Your jollof is not watery because of the rice, it is the tomatoes, is strong.

panel.heading: Hook, value, one call to action
items: Hook: the first line must stop the scroll
Value: details, benefits, a short story
Call to action: exactly what to do next
Give a price or a 'from' price

say: The value is the useful middle: details, benefits, a short story or tips. Write the way you speak to a customer.

say: Plan every video in three parts. The hook comes first, because many viewers decide within seconds. Esther in Onitsha opened with tiger nuts poured into a blender, and the words, can it blend tiger nuts?

panel.heading: Plan and film a short Reel
items: Hook in the first 1 to 3 seconds
Body: short clips, no waiting
Call to action in the last seconds
Clean lens, window light, phone steady
Add auto-captions for sound-off viewers

say: The body shows the process in short clips, cutting out any waiting. Esther used four 3-second clips, ending with a glass of smooth tiger-nut milk.

Post the clean file on each platform, without another app's watermark.

say: Stories disappear after 24 hours and reach people who already care about you. Every poll or question reply opens a private chat, a natural moment to sell. Keep prices, reviews and how to order in Highlights.

A Live builds trust fast. Kemi, a fabric seller in Lagos, announced hers with a countdown, held each lace to the light, repeated prices, and pinned her WhatsApp link. Customers ordered the same evening.

Amaka runs a cake business in Enugu. A customer comments that her cake arrived with the top crushed. Within an hour Amaka replies publicly: I am so sorry, I have sent you a message so we can make this right today.
Never delete honest complaints or argue in public. Other customers are watching.

panel.heading: Rescue a public complaint
items: Reply publicly within the hour, calmly
Move to private chat and ask for details
Offer a fair fix
Fix the real cause

say: On WhatsApp she asks for a photo and the order details, and learns the rider was stuck in traffic on a hot afternoon.

say: During busy Lives, fake payment screenshots and fake bank alerts are common. Release goods only after you see the money in your own bank or payment app.
And protect your customers. Never post a phone number, address or payment detail in comments, and blur personal details in any chat screenshot.

panel.heading: Money and customer data
items: Confirm payment in your own bank app
Never ship on a screenshot or SMS
No phone numbers or addresses in comments
Blur personal details in screenshots

say: To remember. Give every post one job. Write a hook, value and one call to action. Plan videos as hook, body and call to action. Answer the question first, then move to private chat. And confirm payment before you ship.

panel.heading: Remember
items: One job per post: discover, trust or sell
Hook, value, one call to action
Video: hook, body, call to action
Answer the question, then go private
Confirm payment before you ship
